# Ryan Duguid

> Ryan Duguid is a Senior Accountant in Newcastle, NSW, Australia. He builds open source tools for Australian accounting: Excel LAMBDA functions, month-end review pipelines, tax and payroll calculation engines, a local MCP server and AI agent workflows. Public examples use fabricated data.

This file indexes the GitHub repositories. The canonical, more detailed index of the website and its tools is https://duguid.com.au/llms.txt. Version numbers and counts change with each release; read them from the linked repository or release page.

- Location: Newcastle, NSW, Australia. Jurisdiction: Commonwealth of Australia (ATO, AASB, IFRS, TPB).
- Credentials: provisional member of Chartered Accountants ANZ, as stated by the profile owner and not endorsed by Chartered Accountants ANZ. SAP S/4HANA certified in Financial Accounting (FI) and Management Accounting (CO). Xero Certified Specialist, Level 3, awarded 1 July 2026 and valid until 1 July 2027 (certificate: https://duguid.com.au/evidence/#xero-certification).
- Contact: ryan@duguid.com.au or https://duguid.com.au/contact/. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ryan-duguid/.
- Not the United States software product executive of the same name, whose LinkedIn URL has no hyphen.

## Boundary

- Ryan Duguid is not a registered tax agent or BAS agent. The repositories are free software, not a practice, and do not take advice, return preparation, tax-treatment confirmation or lodgement requests.
- Support covers software issues reproduced with fabricated data. Do not send taxpayer information, client files or credentials.
- The tools prepare and review work. They do not lodge, post to ledgers, make payments, approve files or lock periods; those stay with an accountable human.

## Start here

- [Tools on the website](https://duguid.com.au/tools/): browser tools and fictional worked examples, with nothing to install.
- [Profit and cash worked example](https://duguid.com.au/examples/profit-vs-cash-flow/): a fictional Newcastle business where delaying one $44,000 receipt by 45 days leaves quarterly profit at $35,957.55 while daily cash falls to minus $25,160 on 6 November 2026.
- [Monthly Close Controls worked example](https://duguid.com.au/tools/monthly-close-controls/#worked-example): eight exceptions in a fictional July close, including a $250 creditors difference.
- [Evaluations](https://duguid.com.au/evaluate/) and [Evidence](https://duguid.com.au/evidence/): reproducible synthetic evaluations, credentials, releases and accepted upstream work.

## Repositories

- [Ozzit](https://github.com/ryanduguid/Ozzit): native Excel LAMBDA functions and help tables for GST arithmetic and financial modelling, including financial-year labels, depreciation and AASB 16 lessee schedules. No macros or add-ins; needs Microsoft 365 or Excel 2024 or later. Overview: https://duguid.com.au/tools/ozzit/.
- [australian-accounting](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting): local calculation engines for ATO small business benchmarks, Payday Super timing and Division 7A loan review, available through the aus-accounting-mcp server.
- [aus-accounting-mcp](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/apps/aus-accounting-mcp): local MCP server over stdio for those engines and a set of tax and super worksheets. Install with `uvx aus-accounting-mcp`. Registry name: io.github.ryanduguid/aus-accounting. Unsupported Division 7A matters are refused, and it ships no ATO document library. The MCP host still sends tool arguments and results to its model provider.
- [australian-accounting-skills](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills): preparation and review workflows for public practice and contracting, including BAS, month-end close, payroll, workpaper tie-outs and the former Hardhat Ledger subcontractor workflows (there is no separate Hardhat pack). Claude Code plugin, Codex plugin or portable skill files; `npx skills add ryanduguid/australian-accounting-skills` installs from the default branch.
- [accounting-review-pipeline](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline): month-end close checks on Xero trial balance exports, producing exception packs for human sign-off, with Excel and Power BI components.
- [au-fpa-pack](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-fpa-pack): Australian extension of openfpa by Jeff Brines and Guiderail, with 30 June years, Xero AU and GST. Holds the source for the profit and cash example; its independent accountant trial is pending.
- [llm-tax-guardrails](https://github.com/ryanduguid/llm-tax-guardrails): APES 110 and TPB Code controls, refusal patterns and evaluation fixtures for firms using LLMs in tax work. Conclusions stay with the registered practitioner.
- [au-tax-legislation-corpus](https://github.com/ryanduguid/au-tax-legislation-corpus): builds a retrieval corpus from in-force Commonwealth tax legislation on the Federal Register of Legislation, with source and provenance records. It is a finding aid, not authorised legislation.

## Optional

- [payday-super-checker](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/packages/payday-super-checker): Payday Super contribution timelines and experimental SG charge exposure. Not an ATO assessment.
- [ato-benchmark-compare](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/packages/ato-benchmark-compare): offline profit and loss comparison against ATO small business benchmarks.
- [TheExchequerTally](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/packages/the-exchequer-tally): company tax rate from operator-established facts (base rate entity test, s 23AA ITRA 1986), franking account balance and Division 203.
- [SolomonsSword](https://github.com/ryanduguid/australian-accounting/tree/main/packages/solomons-sword): trust income allocation under Division 6 ITAA 1936, s 100A and s 99B.
- [xero-trial-balance-export](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/xero-trial-balance-export): Xero trial balance exporter; movement and year to date must both tie before a CSV is written.
- [Monthly Close Controls](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/monthly-close-control-plane): local trial balance review packs with exception surfacing (distribution `monthly-close-control-plane`). It does not approve or lock a close.
- [Workpaper Review Gate](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/review-ready-gate): checks whether a BAS, month-end or year-end pack is ready for manager review (distribution `review-ready-gate`, command `review-ready`). READY is not sign-off.
- [Xero Ledger Review Gate](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/packages/elizabeth-anne-alexander): synthetic demonstration of a fixed-policy trial balance review boundary (distribution and command `elizabeth-anne-alexander`).
- [accounting-excel-toolkit](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/adapters/accounting-excel-toolkit): Power Query (M) and VBA automation for Australian month-end reporting.
- [Australian Accounting Power BI](https://github.com/ryanduguid/accounting-review-pipeline/tree/main/apps/australian-accounting-power-bi): source-controlled Power BI project for accounting analytics, consolidation, ATO benchmarks and Payday Super review.
- [Related resources](https://duguid.com.au/tools/#related-resources): third-party libraries, ATO guidance and legislation sources, kept on the website.
